target: Fleet token-truncation standard: one shared helper implementing progressive item-by-item truncation under a 9K-token response budget plus MCP-boundary truncation at call_tool() TextContent; adopted by conport and dope-memory first.
invariants: Truncation is signaled, never silent: responses carry a truncation marker and paging hint.

commit.message: feat(mcp): shared progressive token-truncation helper; adopt in conport + dope-memory

pr.title: feat(mcp): fleet token-truncation standard
pr.body:
Recovers the archived CONPORT_TOKEN_LIMIT_FIX / LEANTIME_TOKEN_LIMIT_FIX patterns lost in migration: progressive item-by-item truncation to a 9K budget and a final guard at the MCP call_tool() TextContent boundary. Spec + shared helper + first two adopters.

Anchor: claudedocs/mcp-fleet-reconciliation-2026-07-18.md (P7/HRD).

steps.task: Write the truncation spec (docs/03-reference/mcp/) and the shared helper with unit tests (budget edges, marker, paging hint).
validation: Helper truncates an oversized item list progressively, emits the truncation marker, and unit tests cover under/at/over-budget cases.

steps.task: Adopt the helper in conport and dope-memory tool responses (list-shaped tools first) with regression tests.
validation: Oversized get_decisions / memory_search responses stay under budget with the marker present; regression tests added for both servers.

steps.task: Document per-server adoption status and the rollout path for the remaining fleet.
validation: Docs page lists adoption status per server with owners for the un-adopted remainder.
